facts.fact: KRAY在梦中是个叫Nick的四岁小男孩，父亲在外打仗，他站在加州Ventura附近的绿松石色泳池边。
facts.anchor: KRAY is a small boy called Nick. He’s maybe four years old, tops. And his dad is off fighting a war somewhere. And he’s standing beside this turquoise pool, somewhere right in the vicinity of Ventura, California

facts.fact: 阳台上一位约二十一岁的Ventura年轻女子伸手指向Nick说：“I want that one.”
facts.anchor:
right up there is this lovely young Ventura, California, woman, and she’s about twenty-one years old, give or take.

And for some reason no one can figure out, this particular twenty-one-year-old woman is just very, very pretty to this small boy of four. Then she directs one of her slender, well-tended index fingers straight toward Nick, and I swear she says, “I want that one.

facts.fact: 随后约七岁的Nick坐在英国牛津一所寒冷严酷的天主教预科学校的冰冷马桶座上。
facts.anchor: Then he is sitting on this freezing cold toilet seat in this freezing cold toilet stall somewhere deep within this freezing cold and severe Catholic preparatory school made out of this freezing cold stone and dark wood and suffering and located somewhere right in the middle of freezing cold Oxford, England.

facts.fact: 女孩Nadia的父母把她从波兰带到英国，她跑过Nick身旁时在他脸颊上亲了一下，这是他的初吻。
facts.anchor:
And her parents brought her to England from Poland, but she’s all English now. And that hair of hers smells the way you wish everything would always smell and never stop.

And she and that hair of hers run past Nick in an echoing marble hallway, and as she goes by, she plants a kiss right on Nick

facts.fact: Nick十三岁，和所有童子军一样喜欢圣诞节，他可能是最喜欢的一个。
facts.anchor: But anyway, all the Scouts like Christmas. And Nick, at thirteen, he likes it best of all, probably.

facts.fact: 另一个也叫Nadia的十三岁女孩嘴唇涂着唇彩、身上有风信子气味，她告诉Nick她爱他。
facts.anchor: a beautiful thirteen-year-old girl and, curiously, her name is Nadia, too, and she has these very lip-glossy lips and she smells like hyacinth. And she has told Nick she loves him.

facts.fact: KRAY（Nick）穿着衣服和鞋醒来，满身是汗；Veronica哭着告诉他人事部门要把她调去Queen Maud Land，并说Wacker和FILBERT在周五下午晚些时候叫她开会。
facts.anchor:
Then all at once he wakes up, fully dressed including shoes, and soaked in sweat, and head ablaze, and at first not quite sure where he is. But he is sure of one thing. He is sure Veronica told him Personnel was reassigning her to Queen Maud Land. She told him that through tears.

She told him Wacker and FILBERT had called her into a meeting late on Friday afternoon
